modules.name: Notice Board and Event Invite
modules.description: Lets Raghuvir Admins and Society Managers publish announcements, celebrations, events and urgent notices to selected projects or buildings and notify the target users.

requirements.title: Choose notice type
requirements.description: The poster picks the type of post: Announcement, Celebration, Event or Urgent.

requirements.title: Capture notice content and display dates
requirements.description: The poster adds a title, a message, an optional image, and show-from and show-until dates.

requirements.title: Select audience for a post
requirements.description: The poster picks who sees the post: all projects, selected projects or selected buildings for Raghuvir Admin; own project or selected buildings in it for a Society Manager.

requirements.title: Capture event details and invited age group
requirements.description: For an Event, the poster enters date, time, venue and an optional invited age group such as Kids or Seniors.

requirements.title: Show post on selected notice boards and notify users
requirements.description: On publish, the post shows only on the notice boards of the selected projects and a notification goes to those users.

requirements.title: Age-group targeted notification
requirements.description: When an invited age group is set, the notification goes only to families with members in that group, while the post stays visible to the whole project.

requirements.title: Move expired posts to Past
requirements.description: After the show-until date, the post moves to Past.

requirements.title: Mark edited posts as Updated and renotify
requirements.description: When a post is edited after publish, it is marked Updated and the target users are notified again.

requirements.title: Mark cancelled events and notify
requirements.description: When an event is cancelled, it is marked Cancelled and the target users are notified.

requirements.title: Scheduled publishing
requirements.description: When publish is set for a later time, the post appears and notifies at that time.

rules.title: Society Manager posting permission and scope
rules.description: A Society Manager can post only with the Post notices permission, and only to their own project or selected buildings in it.

rules.title: Notice board is read-only
rules.description: The board is for reading only: no replies and no comments.
